answer: Make every new identity pay an onboarding fee into a shared vault, rising quadratically for each extra identity traced to the same funding source, so the tenth fake account costs a hundred times the first and a sybil farm bankrupts itself before it earns anything. A mirror ledger publishes every funding trail in crystal-clear form so anyone can audit shared wallets, and the fees collected flow back to honest miners as a bonus, turning the attacker's money into the network's reward.
